description: This file is a shell script for testing concurrent git svn dcommit operations. It includes setup procedures for SVN repository hooks, test cases for various scenarios involving SVN commits, hook failures, and conflict resolution, as well as auxiliary functions to facilitate testing workflows.

methods.name: next_N
methods.description: Increments the counter variable N used to generate unique directory names for test repositories.

methods.name: setup_hook
methods.description: Configures SVN hooks (pre-commit or post-commit) to simulate failures or concurrent commits during testing.

methods.name: check_contents
methods.description: Verifies that the contents of specific files match expected contents after tests.

methods.name: delete_first_line
methods.description: Utility function to remove the first line from a specified file, used in some test scenarios.
